title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra Faces Battery Issues Post-Update
description: The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is facing battery problems after a recent update, as reported by various sources.

sources.title: History repeats itself as Galaxy S25 Ultra and S24 Ultra users get hit by another frustrating issue
Battery Problems on Your Samsung Phone After July Update? You're Not Alone
Galaxy S25 Ultra and S24 Ultra Face (once again) the same issue after latest update

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Samsung's Galaxy S25 Ultra is a flagship smartphone model that has been in the news due to issues arising from a recent update.

sections.heading: Issues Reported
paragraphs: According to PhoneArena, the Galaxy S25 Ultra and its predecessor, the S24 Ultra, are experiencing a frustrating issue after the latest update. PCMag reports that users of these Samsung models are not alone in facing battery problems following the July update. Gizchina.com also notes that both the S25 Ultra and S24 Ultra are facing the same issue post-update.

sections.heading: User Impact
paragraphs: The impact of these issues on users is significant, as battery performance is a critical aspect of smartphone functionality.

faq.q: What is the issue with the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra?
faq.a: The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is facing battery problems after a recent update, as reported by PhoneArena, PCMag, and Gizchina.com.

faq.q: Is this issue isolated to the S25 Ultra?
faq.a: No, the S24 Ultra is also facing the same issue, as mentioned by PhoneArena and Gizchina.com.
